presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Legacy-compatible field preserved for existing OAC content.

presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Legacy-compatible field preserved for existing OAC content.

presentationColumns.name: SKU ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.SKU ID
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Legacy-compatible field preserved for existing OAC content.

presentationColumns.name: Collection ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Collection ID
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Legacy-compatible field preserved for existing OAC content.

presentationColumns.name: On Hand Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Snapshot On Hand Units
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias for Snapshot On Hand Units. Prefer Snapshot On Hand Units in new content. Physical stock on hand in the weekly inventory snapshot at store-SKU-week grain. Use it for point-in-time operational inventory reporting; use Inventory Movement KPIs for opening-to-ending flow analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Available Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Snapshot Available Units
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias for Snapshot Available Units. Prefer Snapshot Available Units in new content. Sellable units in the weekly inventory snapshot after reservations or unavailable stock are excluded. Use it for point-in-time availability reporting.

presentationColumns.name: Reserved Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Snapshot Reserved Units
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias for Snapshot Reserved Units. Prefer Snapshot Reserved Units in new content. Reserved units in the weekly inventory snapshot that are physically on hand but not immediately sellable.

presentationColumns.name: Latest Known Store-SKU On Hand Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Latest Known Store-SKU On Hand Units
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Last known physical stock on hand at store-SKU grain. Use this with the snapshot week to understand store availability when a SKU is not present in every weekly inventory snapshot.

presentationColumns.name: Latest Known Store-SKU Available Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Latest Known Store-SKU Available Units
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Last known sellable inventory at store-SKU grain after reservations and unavailable stock. Use this with the snapshot week to identify possible transfer candidates and judge how fresh the inventory status is.

presentationColumns.name: Latest Known Store-SKU Reserved Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Latest Known Store-SKU Reserved Units
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Last known reserved inventory at store-SKU grain. Use this beside latest known available units to understand why on-hand stock may not be fully transferable.

presentationColumns.name: Stockout Count
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Snapshot Stockout Count
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias for Snapshot Stockout Count. Prefer Snapshot Stockout Count in new content. Count of weekly store-SKU snapshots flagged as stockout. This is an operational snapshot count, not an AI alert count.

presentationColumns.name: Inventory Value At Cost
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Snapshot Inventory Value At Cost
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias for Snapshot Inventory Value At Cost. Prefer Snapshot Inventory Value At Cost in new content. Inventory value at standard cost for the weekly inventory snapshot.

presentationColumns.name: Average Weeks Of Supply
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Average Snapshot Weeks Of Supply
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias for Average Snapshot Weeks Of Supply. Prefer Average Snapshot Weeks Of Supply in new content. Average estimated weeks of supply across weekly inventory snapshots in the selected context.

presentationColumns.name: Average Store-SKU Overstock Risk Index
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Average Store-SKU Overstock Risk Index
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Historical average raw overstock risk index at store-SKU-week grain; not scaled to 0-100.

presentationColumns.name: Average Store-SKU Stockout Risk Index
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Average Store-SKU Stockout Risk Index
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Historical average raw stockout risk index at store-SKU-week grain; not scaled to 0-100.

presentationColumns.name: Current Store-SKU Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Current Store-SKU Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Latest-week store-SKU stockout risk rescaled to a 0-100 dashboard score. Use this for current inventory risk because it avoids diluting the latest state with older weeks.

presentationColumns.name: Current Store-SKU Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Current Store-SKU Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Latest-week store-SKU overstock risk rescaled to a 0-100 dashboard score. Use this for current overstock monitoring because it reflects the latest available inventory snapshot.

presentationColumns.name: Available Unit Share
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Snapshot Available Unit Share
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias for Snapshot Available Unit Share. Prefer Snapshot Available Unit Share in new content. Snapshot available units as a percentage of snapshot on-hand units.

presentationColumns.name: Scenario Tag
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Scenario Tag
presentationColumns.description: Legacy-compatible alias preserved for existing OAC content. Same business meaning as the cleaned folder version. Internal data-generation scenario marker; hidden from business-facing analysis.

presentationTable.description: Legacy-compatible alias for Base Warehouse - Inventory Snapshot KPIs. Existing OAC analyses can continue to use this folder path; prefer Base Warehouse - Inventory Snapshot KPIs for new content. Base warehouse weekly inventory snapshots from FASHIONDW.FACT_INVENTORY_SNAPSHOT_WEEKLY. Use this for stock position, latest known availability, and snapshot risk reporting.
